{{nihongo|'''Sugō Shrine'''|菅生神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Bitchū Province]].

'''Sugō Shrine''' (すごうじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Yuasu, {{ill|Kurashiki|ar|كوراشيكي (أوكاياما)|arz|كوراشيكى|az|Kuraşiki|be|Курасікі|bg|Курашики|ce|Курасики|ceb|Kurashiki (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Kurašiki|de|Kurashiki|eo|Kuraŝiki|es|Kurashiki|eu|Kurashiki (Okayama)|fa|کوراشیکی، اوکایاما|fi|Kurashiki|fr|Kurashiki|ga|Kurashiki|gl|Kurashiki|hy|Կուրասիկի (քաղաք)|id|Kurashiki, Okayama|it|Kurashiki|ja|倉敷市|ka|კურასიკი|ko|구라시키시|lt|Kurašikis|mg|Kurashiki|mzn|کوراشیکی، اوکایاما|nl|Kurashiki|no|Kurashiki|pl|Kurashiki|pt|Kurashiki|ro|Kurashiki|ru|Курасики|sh|Kurashiki|simple|Kurashiki|sl|Kurašiki|sr|Курашики|sv|Kurashiki|tg|Курашики|th|คูราชิกิ|tl|Kurashiki|tr|Kurashiki|tt|Курасики|uk|Курасікі|ur|کوراشیکی، اوکایاما|uz|Koʻrasiki|vi|Kurashiki|war|Kurashiki, Okayama|zh|倉敷市|zh_classical|倉敷市|zh_min_nan|Kurasiki-chhī|zh_yue|倉敷|qid=Q467487}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|Q132936|qid=Q132936}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former shrine rank was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. It is also called '''Himeōkami''' (姫太神).

=== Enshrined deities ===
;Primary deity
*{{ill|Takamimusubi|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi-no-Kami}} (たかみむすひのかみ)

;Associated deity
*Himeōkami (ひめおおかみ)

=== History ===
The date of foundation is unknown. In ancient times, it is said to have been enshrined in Miwa-go, {{ill|Kuboya district|Q11597661|qid=Q11597661}}, {{ill|Bitchū Province|Q1047514|qid=Q1047514}}, where it was revered as the chief guardian shrine of the area. It is also said that its former location was within what is now {{ill|Sōja|Q873536|qid=Q873536}}. Sugō Shrine is considered one of the leading candidate shrines (ronsha) for the Sugō Shrine listed as one of the 18 shrines in Bitchū Province recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448|lt=Engi}} {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and one of the three within Kuboya District. There is also a record stating that in the 2nd year of {{ill|Gangyō|Q747451|qid=Q747451}} ({{ill|878|Q23910|qid=Q23910}}), in {{ill|February (Lunisolar)|Q838935|qid=Q838935|lt=February}}, the shrine—then ranked Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade in Bitchū Province—was granted promotion to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade. The parish area (ujiko) covers the Yuasu district of Kurashiki City, and the shrine is the origin of the place name Sugō Village (now the {{ill|Sugō|ja|菅生地区 (倉敷市)|qid=Q11619328|lt=Sugō}} district of Kurashiki City).

=== Shrine grounds ===
There are no buildings other than the shrine structures. The main sanctuary consists of two main halls (Sugō Shrine and Himeōkami) connected together.
